$comment: Tripo v3 生成用マニフェスト（tools/tripo.mjs が読む・手書き）。配色は HeroBlueprints / Theme.heroHue / HeroPalettes に合わせる。武器・浮遊物・光輪・翼・発光エフェクトは実行時に付けるので本体には描かない。本体の役名は武器を連想させない語にする（assassin・gunner など）。まず run heroes ... --until concept でコンセプト画像に武器・ホルスター・鞘が無いことを確かめてから model 以降を買う。

style.bodyPrefix: Single original unarmed fantasy MOBA hero, full body, strict T-pose: arms straight out horizontally, open empty hands with spread fingers, legs straight with feet slightly apart, front view.
style.bodySuffix: Stylized hand-painted game art, clean readable silhouette for a top-down camera, slightly large head (about 1/5 of height), sturdy legs and feet, character centered with margin, plain light-gray background, even soft lighting, no text, no logo.
style.bodyNegative: weapon, sword, dagger, shield, bow, staff, spear, gun, book, lantern, held item, holster, scabbard, sheath, floating orb, halo, wings on back, particles, magic effects, extra limbs, cropped, multiple characters, text, watermark, logo, bare thighs, exposed underwear, revealing outfit
style.propPrefix: Single stylized fantasy MOBA game item, one object only, upright and perfectly vertical:
style.propSuffix: Orthographic view, centered with margin, whole object visible, plain light-gray background, even soft lighting, stylized hand-painted texture, chunky readable shapes for a top-down game camera, no hands, no text, no logo.
style.propNegative: hand, person, character, multiple objects, duplicates, tilted, diagonal, cropped, perspective, cast shadow, floor, particles, smoke, sparks, background scenery, text, watermark, logo
style.skinPrefix: Repaint this exact character keeping the same design, shapes and details; change only colors, materials and surface patterns.
style.skinSuffix: Keep the original face and skin tone. Stylized hand-painted game texture, clean readable color blocks.

heroes.prompt: Burly armored knight guardian (man), heavy broad build. Full silver plate armor with golden-yellow enamel panels, huge rounded pauldrons with castle-battlement rims, layered plate tassets over the hips, golden-yellow tabard with an azure-blue gate emblem.
